name: Supine crunch
definition: Lie on the back with knees bent, feet on floor and hands lightly across the chest. Curl the upper trunk to lift the shoulder blades, then lower.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie on the back with knees bent, feet on floor and hands lightly across the chest.
value.movement: Curl the upper trunk to lift the shoulder blades, then lower.
value.finish: Return the upper back to floor support.
value.range_of_motion: A short trunk curl rather than a full sit-up; use a repeatable shoulder-blade lift.
